E-mu z-plane grammar

One row per section occurrence; every frequency at the native 39,062.5 Hz datum, de-warped to continuous acoustic Hz by the inverse bilinear transform. Binary contract verified upstream — this notebook studies structure, not bytes.
table rows meaning
sections 16,976 one section occurrence
states 7,914 distinct live section states
subsets 4,606 lane combinations recurring across filters
scaffolds 141 "N shared + 1 replaced" edges
Live sections: 12,280 of 16,976 — the rest are sentinels, self-cancelling pairs and idle-pole filler that cannot affect the response.
